  Pull the bar toward your belly button, then slowly and with control, lower it back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions. The latissimus dorsi extends the shoulders with the assistance of the posterior deltoid. The rhomboids and middle trapezius retract the scapulae. The posterior chain muscles stabilize the body and maintain the bent-over position, enabling efficient force transfer throughout the movement. Common mistake, rounded back during the lift. This exercise is intended to strengthen the latissimus dorsi in the posterior chain. Difficulty performing the lift with a neutral spine may result from tight hamstrings or lack of awareness. To correct this, incorporate hamstring stretches to improve flexibility and focus on engaging the back muscles to maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
